sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.price_per_unit), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Bakery'

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders so JOIN employees e ON e.id = so.employee_id WHERE so.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN so.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Hail' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01'
SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.price_per_unit), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Beverages'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Qassim' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01'

SELECT e.name FROM sales_orders so JOIN employees e ON e.id = so.employee_id WHERE so.placed_on >= '2025-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN so.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'enterprise' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-07-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND paid_at >= '2024-01-01' AND paid_at < '2024-04-01'

SELECT p.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) - l.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON sol.order_id = so.id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'retail' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-04-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-07-01'
SELECT COUNT(ci.id) FROM cities ci JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Eastern Province'
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'retail'

SELECT c.customer_tier AS segment, ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(l.quantity,0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS avg_units_per_order FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_tier ORDER BY CAST(SUM(COALESCE(l.quantity,0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.channel FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_order_lines oi JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = oi.order_id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND c.customer_tier = 'retail' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'bank_transfer' AND paid_at >= '2024-10-01' AND paid_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'missing_item' AND closed_at IS NULL

WITH line AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS emp, l.id AS line_id, l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) AS rev FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01'), ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(line.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(ref.refunded), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM line JOIN employees e ON e.id = line.emp LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.order_item_id = line.line_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'retail'

SELECT c.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

WITH line_rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, l.id AS line_id, l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) AS rev FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01'), ref AS (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT e.name AS name, ROUND(SUM(lr.rev) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refunded), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM line_rev lr JOIN employees e ON e.id = lr.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref r ON r.order_item_id = lr.line_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name FROM cities c JOIN clients cl ON cl.city_id = c.id JOIN sales_orders so ON so.customer_id = cl.id WHERE so.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(so.id) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.name FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01') OR (o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01')) GROUP BY r.id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(rf.refund_total), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_total FROM returns GROUP BY order_item_id) rf ON rf.order_item_id = l.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH r AS (SELECT rg.id AS region_id, rg.name AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-07-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions rg ON rg.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND ((o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01') OR (o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-07-01')) GROUP BY rg.id, rg.name) SELECT name, ROUND((rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 100.0 / rev_2024, 2) AS growth_pct FROM r WHERE rev_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (rev_2025 - rev_2024) * 1.0 / rev_2024 ASC, name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT so.channel FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON so.id = sol.order_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-10-01' AND so.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY so.channel ORDER BY SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN clients c ON so.customer_id = c.id JOIN cities ci ON c.city_id = ci.id JOIN regions r ON ci.region_id = r.id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Qassim' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-04-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'shipped'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON e.city_id = c.id WHERE e.role = 'account_manager' AND c.name = 'Taif'

SELECT customer_tier FROM (SELECT c.customer_tier AS customer_tier, SUM(l.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_units FROM sales_orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.customer_tier ORDER BY avg_units DESC, c.customer_tier LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM clients WHERE customer_tier = 'wholesale'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-04-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.placed_on >= '2025-04-01')
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON e.city_id = c.id WHERE e.role = 'account_manager' AND c.name = 'Jubail'
SELECT ROUND(MAX(p.price_per_unit), 2) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Electronics'

SELECT c.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-07-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT c.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2025-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0) - sol.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM sales_order_lines sol JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = sol.product_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND so.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0) - sol.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH closed AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs FROM closed GROUP BY customer_id), order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM sales_orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca JOIN order_counts oc ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id WHERE ca.avg_hrs > (SELECT AVG(hrs) FROM closed) AND oc.order_cnt >= 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Tabuk')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-10-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.placed_on >= '2025-10-01')

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN sales_orders s ON s.employee_id = e.id WHERE s.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND s.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2025-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' THEN l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT region_name FROM rev WHERE rev_2024 > 0 ORDER BY (rev_2025 - rev_2024) / rev_2024 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT c.name FROM cities c JOIN clients cl ON c.id = cl.city_id WHERE cl.name = 'Qahtani Supermarkets'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clients c WHERE c.created_at < '2026-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.placed_on >= '2026-01-01')
SELECT price_per_unit FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0058'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'urgent' AND opened_at >= '2024-01-01' AND opened_at < '2025-01-01'

SELECT c.name FROM sales_orders so JOIN sales_order_lines sol ON so.id = sol.order_id JOIN products p ON sol.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(sol.quantity * sol.price_per_unit * (1 - sol.discount_percent / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'damaged_item' AND closed_at IS NULL
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON e.city_id = c.id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Al Ula'

SELECT o.channel FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.placed_on >= '2024-07-01' AND o.placed_on < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.price_per_unit * (1 - l.discount_percent / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND opened_at >= '2024-07-01' AND opened_at < '2024-10-01'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit * (1 - oi.discount_percent / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales_order_lines oi JOIN sales_orders so ON so.id = oi.order_id JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE so.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND so.placed_on >= '2024-01-01' AND so.placed_on < '2024-07-01'
SELECT COUNT(ci.id) FROM cities ci JOIN regions re ON re.id = ci.region_id WHERE re.name = 'Madinah'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'account' AND closed_at IS NULL

SELECT substr(o.placed_on,1,7) AS month FROM sales_order_lines l JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE o.placed_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_on < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.placed_on,1,7) ORDER BY CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns rt JOIN sales_order_lines l2 ON l2.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN sales_orders o2 ON o2.id = l2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.placed_on,1,7) = substr(o.placed_on,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(l.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT ci.name FROM sales_orders so JOIN clients c ON c.id = so.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE so.placed_on >= '2024-10-01' AND so.placed_on < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(so.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
